assessments.reasoning: Regarding member_to_member_relationships, the text mentions a 'relationship grid' and 'Relationship to HRP' but does not substantiate that relationships are collected member-to-member (matrix or pointer variables) rather than only relative to the Household Reference Person (HRP). Regarding extended_ties, while relationship to HRP is recorded, the text does not detail categories to substantiate that extended ties beyond spouse and parent-child (such as grandparents, siblings, non-kin, or same-sex partners) can be identified. Regarding multiple_household_criteria, the text explicitly states the criteria for separating households as 'one person living alone or a group of people (not necessarily related) living at the same address who share cooking facilities and share a living room or sitting room or dining area.' Regarding sub_units, the text establishes that family sub-units within households are identified and assigned derived variables. Regarding caregiving_relationships, the text explicitly states that 'Carers' is not included on the LFS.
